note:
The hundred capabilities are the owner's list, in the owner's order. They are not a
hundred packages: each row says what kind of thing it is (an outside tool, something the
agent host does, a local script, a hub component or a working rule) and how far it got
here. The status words are:

capabilities.name: Headroom Compression
capabilities.implementation: Headroom through hr (0.44.0) and the hub tool tools/headroom_context.py (0.45.0)

capabilities.name: Reversible Context Compression
capabilities.implementation: hr keeps every original by SHA-256 and returns it on request

capabilities.name: JSON Structural Compression
capabilities.implementation: Headroom's JSON transform: arrays become a table with every row

capabilities.name: Repetitive Log Compression
capabilities.implementation: Headroom's log transform, called directly by hr

capabilities.name: Tool Output Compression
capabilities.implementation: hr wraps a command and prints a view of its output

capabilities.name: Selective Context Retrieval
capabilities.implementation: hr get by line range or pattern; Read with offset and limit

capabilities.name: Context Fidelity Verification
capabilities.implementation: hr appends every error line a view lost; hr verify rechecks the checksum

capabilities.name: Context Deduplication
capabilities.implementation: hr never compresses a view twice; the store is content-addressed

capabilities.name: Context Budget Management
capabilities.implementation: bands in the skill; swarm/protect.py holds the experiment's limits

capabilities.name: Adaptive Compression Routing
capabilities.implementation: hr picks the transform from the command and the shape of the text

capabilities.name: Context Mode
capabilities.implementation: context-mode 2.1.10 as a standalone stdio server on its own Node 24

capabilities.name: Local Output Indexing
